elaine: Hotfix ready — memory leak in inference runtime fixed. Need 2x LGTM before 23:59 PT cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8793
sam: :eyes: ETA to merge? CI is flaky right now.
marta: I can give a quick review, but James (owner) is PTO til 20:00 PT. He hasn't set a delegate.
elaine: We need two approvals. James is the primary owner. Can someone stand in? @sam or @liam?
sam: I can do second approve if smoke passes. Will run quick glassbox.
devops-bot: [ci] build #1428 failed — integration-smoke (kicked by elaine)
liam: failing test is infra: 'kv-cache-warmup.test' — seen it before; rerun helps.
sam: Rerunning smoke now: `./scripts/ci/run_smoke.sh pr/8793`
sam: smoke output:
```
FAILED kv-cache-warmup.test -- timeout after 120s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/kv_warmup.py", line 42, in test_warmup
    assert cache.size() > 0
TimeoutError: cache init timed out
```
liam: That's the flaky one. Try with env VAR `KV_WARMUP_TIMEOUT=300` and triage logs.
marta: I can look at the diff for the mem leak, quick pass done. +1 for correctness but no perf run.
sam: re-run CI with extended timeout: `ci/retry --job integration-smoke --env KV_WARMUP_TIMEOUT=300`
devops-bot: [ci] build #1429 started — integration-smoke (rerun by sam)
elaine: If build passes, can @sam and @marta stamp 2x LGTM? We're under cutoff.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll give LGTM after green and quick perf check. If green, approve in 15m.
marta: :+1: will add 'needs-merge' label once approved.
james: (away) leaving note — ok to delegate to Sam if emergency. flagged in calendar.
elaine: thanks @james. If we don't have 2x LGTM by 23:45 PT, plan B is to hold and roll into next window.
liam: alternative: if build passes but post-merge smoke flakes, we have rollback tag and autobackout for 30m window.
sam: devops-bot just posted: [ci] build #1429 succeeded — integration-smoke
sam: quick perf: p95 latency unchanged on small run. Approving now.
sam: LGTM
marta: LGTM — adding 'needs-merge'
elaine: merging in 2 min, canary for 10% traffic for 15m. If anything odd, rollback.
deploy-bot: will schedule canary deploy at 23:52 PT to pool 'canary-small' — tag: pr-8793
elaine: :tada: thanks everyone, closing loop.
